feature: 通用报告展示与可编辑反馈区
snapshot_scope: Local validation before Git publication; subsequent commits and remote refs record publication, not deployment.

contract.scope: Shared web/desktop attachment viewer; not an HR-specific component

fields.definition: Stable field ID, editable label, type, required flag and choice options. Definitions and typed values use JSONB, not 20 fixed database columns.
fields.evolution: Once records exist, existing types, fields and options cannot be removed or reinterpreted. Optional fields and choices may be added. Archived records still protect the schema.

contract.records: Record name, typed values, optional source attachment ID and revision; paginated in pages of 50, not limited to 20 records or files
contract.persistence: PostgreSQL report_feedback_schema, report_feedback_row and report_feedback_change; data and attributed before/after history commit in one transaction
contract.presentation: Existing attachment storage and sandboxed HTML preview. No new public HTML host, same-origin iframe access or HTML-to-database bridge.
contract.collaboration: Permission-checked polling every 5 seconds while open; per-record and schema revision checks; HTTP 409 preserves local input instead of overwriting newer values
contract.permissions: Every endpoint inherits the attachment's current workspace and conversation authorization. Writes recheck access after locking. Linked source files keep their own permissions; narrower conversation sources cannot be linked into broader reports.
contract.human_operations: Authorized readers can add/edit records; uploader or workspace owner/admin configures fields and archives records
contract.agent_operations: Verified task credentials can initialize their own uploaded report and seed new records only. They cannot overwrite existing records or schemas. CLI: multica attachment feedback --help.
contract.historical_reports: Existing static checkboxes are not migrated or interpreted as human decisions. Configure fields and create records explicitly.

review.method: Manual source and architecture review, web-design-guidelines UI review, targeted regression tests and real-browser verification

fixed_findings.finding: A desktop tab's global workspace slug could override the report attachment's explicit workspace ID.
fixed_findings.resolution: Clear the higher-priority inherited slug on all five operations; regression first reproduced the wrong workspace header and then passed.

fixed_findings.finding: A transient refresh error could discard an open draft.
fixed_findings.resolution: Keep drafts and show a stale-data warning for transient errors; still remove private cached data and drafts on 401/403/404.

fixed_findings.finding: Collaborator archival could unmount a record editor and silently lose its unsaved input.
fixed_findings.resolution: Retain the active local draft until explicitly dismissed; server revisions reject stale writes.

fixed_findings.finding: Historical comment-only attachment ownership could leave report feedback behind during deletion.
fixed_findings.resolution: Include direct issue and comment attachment ownership. Test cleanup for attachment, issue/comment, comment, chat session, cancelled user message, system agent and runtime deletion.

fixed_findings.finding: The narrow-screen toolbar overlapped the filename after adding the feedback control.
fixed_findings.resolution: Wrap the toolbar onto a separate row and contain panel scrolling; visually verified at 390px and 1500px.

verification.database: Dedicated local multica_ci_regression_20261017_992; no production data used
verification.tools: Go 1.26.9 and sqlc 1.31.1 in isolated containers; installed workspace TypeScript, ESLint, Vitest and Playwright tools
verification.migrations: 611-614 applied successfully to the isolated database; concurrent indexes each have their own migration; no new foreign keys or cascades

backend.execution: Non-root container with init; fake/missing agent executables only

verification.agent_prompt: TestChatReportFeedbackKeepsPresentationSeparateFromPersistence passed; native feedback instructions do not advertise controls in external-channel replies
verification.go_vet: Passed for reportfeedback, handler, cmd/multica and daemon
verification.typecheck: core, views, web and desktop renderer passed
verification.lint: New core/view code, API client and modified preview components/tests passed
verification.dependency_check: Root knip passed again before commit and merge

pre_publication_recheck.scope: Targeted checks rerun for publication; full backend/frontend/browser results above are retained from the completed feature regression, not claimed as rerun during publication
pre_publication_recheck.documents: Usage guide read back; both JSON examples and acceptance JSON parsed; relative acceptance link verified

verification.translations: Matching report feedback keys in en, zh-Hans, ja, ko and fr

browser.environment: Real Chrome; synthetic users and generic quality report; local web/API and isolated database
covers: preview modal and nested field/record dialogs
workspace removal hides data and denies API access

initial_failures: Root-level Vitest invocation lacked package DOM setup; rerun with each package's own configuration.
Existing preview sequence test mock lacked the new translated toolbar label; mock updated and full suite passed.
Three unrelated role-source UI tests timed out under concurrent full-suite load; full views suite passed with two workers and unchanged test timeouts.
Root/no-init runtime test container failed privilege and process cleanup expectations; non-root/init rerun passed.
Browser test locators were narrowed to a specific history entry and actual workspace-revocation behavior; final full scenario passed.

not_verified: Production deployment and production business-data acceptance
Native Windows/macOS installer execution or packaging
Mobile support or mobile compatibility regression
Live model/Agent generation and feedback-seeding acceptance; no real Agent run or resume batch rerun
release_requirements: Deployment and artifact publication require separate authorization; Git publication does not deploy or update installed runtimes.
Apply migrations and deploy matching backend/web versions.
Build and release updated desktop/CLI/runtime artifacts when those clients need the new UI or Agent feedback commands.
Validate production permissions and live Agent report creation with a separately authorized test scenario.
